posts.title: Welcome to your business site
posts.excerpt: Your Business Starter flagship is live. Edit these posts and pages to match your brand.
posts.content:
This is the Business Starter flagship site.

You already have sample company news, insight articles, and About / Contact pages so visitors see a real company site immediately.

Replace the company name in Site Settings and rewrite these posts with your real offers.

posts.title: How we help clients grow
posts.excerpt: Sample insight post — swap for a real case study or service story.
posts.content:
Use this article as a template for a service story or case study.

Describe a problem, your approach, and the result. Keep it concrete so visitors understand what you deliver.

posts.title: Our services at a glance
posts.excerpt: Short overview of three sample service areas you can rename.
posts.content:
Example service areas:

  • Consulting — strategy and planning
  • Delivery — implementation and support
  • Training — workshops for your team

Edit or delete this post once your real service pages are ready.
